articles.title: Crypto's Washington hopes fade, but Grayscale and BlackRock see growth ahead
articles.snippet: The asset manager says global demand and institutional adoption will sustain the industry despite a political setback, while BlackRock sees little impact on its crypto business.

articles.title: Crypto's powerhouse super PAC suffers costly setback as Democrats sweep Congress
articles.snippet: The industry's primary campaign arm had cultivated a reputation as an unstoppable force, but more than a third of its spending failed to hit the mark, especially in Ohio.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: ICE is betting on retail’s appetite for quick outcomes
articles.snippet: Retail traders increasingly want trades that resolve fast, from prediction markets to same-day options. Andy Baehr of GSR argues perpetual futures belong in that group, and that ICE’s deal to bring Trade[XYZ]’s Hyperliquid markets onshore is a play for that customer, one that doesn’t need a crypto asset to work.

articles.title: Circle beats earnings expectations on strong revenue, but cuts 5% of its workforce
articles.snippet: Circle’s net income for continuing operations of $226 million grew 5% year-over-year to $226 million in the third quarter.

articles.title: Zcash grants committee drops plan to redirect 98,000 ZEC to future mining rewards
articles.snippet: The committee withdrew its proposal after community backlash, leaving competing plans to cut off its funding or preserve the existing grants system.
